project_scope.note: This is the initial Fagaceae family file for the current Hays Botany ID build. Future genera should be merged into it, not blindly replace it.

family_diagnostics.flowers: Wind-pollinated; oak staminate flowers occur in catkins and are usually not the best species-level ID feature.
family_diagnostics.fruit: Nut subtended or surrounded by a cupule; in Quercus this is the acorn and acorn cup.
family_diagnostics.field_tip: For oaks, mature leaves, twig/bud vestiture, bark, acorns, and cupules are much more reliable than flowers alone.
